verdict.rationale: GitLab ships its own agents (Duo Agent Platform), so plugging external MCP servers into them is a fair question. However, the pack contains no evidence that GitLab acts as an MCP client. The MCP evidence covers GitLab serving tools: an official MCP server, and Orbit exposing MCP tools to external agents. Neither shows GitLab's agents consuming third-party MCP servers. The custom-agent tool selection is not tied to MCP, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
